Construct a partitioned buffer from a real (audio) buffer.

Parameters:
originalThe audio buffer to FFT and partition.
startPointThe sample number at which to start reading within the original.
endPointThe sample number at which to stop reading within the original. If this is 0 all the remain samples in the original will be read.
fftEngineThis will control the FFT for operations on the partitioning. Just pass the FFT size to create a FFTEngine of the appropriate size - defaults to 4096.
